title: Mini Sun Tone Bronze + pH Glassy Blush Duo Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Clean at Sephora
What it is: A limited-edition duo for a just-back-from-the-beach flush of color featuring mini bronzing drops and new pH-adaptive blush.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Emollient Oil Blend (Glassy Flush pH-Adaptive Blush Stick): Helps with smooth application, softens skin, and boosts glassy radiance.
- Hydra Nourish Blend (Sun Tone Bronzing Drops): Delivers a nourishing, non-tacky finish with a lightweight feel.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This limited-edition duo pairs Sun Tone Bronzing Drops with a new, limited-edition Glassy Flush pH-Adaptive Blush Stick. The pH-adaptive formula adjusts to your skin's natural chemistry for a personalized flush that looks soft, glassy,
How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
Glassy Flush pH-Adaptive Blush Stick:

-Apply directly to cheeks, working in a small oval motion, blending up and outward as you go.

Sun Tone Bronzing Drops:

-Shake well and apply anywhere the sun would naturally hit—over cheeks, temples, forehead.

-Use with fingers or a brush for a refined finish.

Ingredients+
-Emollient Oil Blend (Glassy Flush pH-Adaptive Blush Stick): Helps with smooth application, softens skin, and boosts glassy radiance.
-Hydra Nourish Blend (Sun Tone Bronzing Drops): Delivers a nourishing, non-tacky finish with a lightweight feel.

Glassy Flush pH-Adaptive Blush Stick (Bellini):
Diisostearyl Malate, Octyldodecanol, Tridecyl Trimellitate, Synthetic Wax, Mica, Dimer Dilinoleyl Dimer Dilinoleate, Glyceryl Behenate/Eicosadioate, Synthetic Beeswax, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Fruit Extract, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Calcium Titanium Borosilicate, Silica, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Tin Oxide, Alumina, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Iron Oxides (CI 77492), Red 6 (CI 15850), Red 7 (CI 15850), Red 27 (CI 45410), Red 28 Lake (CI 45410), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140).

Sun Tone Bronzing Drops (Soleil Parfait 2):
Aqua/Water/Eau, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Octyldodecanol, C10-18 Triglycerides, Mica, Pentylene Glycol, Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Polyglyceryl-4 Caprate, Polyglyceryl-3 Polyricinoleate, Glyceryl Stearate, Xylitol, Capryloyl/Capryloyl Leucine Isosorbide Esters, Isosorbide, Daucus Carota (Carrot) Sativa Seed Oil, Glyceryl Caprylate/Caprate, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Polyglyceryl-3 Diisostearate, Xanthan Gum, Tapioca Starch, Algin, Tocopherol, Potassium Sorbate, Tin Oxide, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491), Iron Oxides (CI) 77492), Iron Oxides (CI 77499).

The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
